name: zrndr_texture_mip_select_variant_image
description: zRndr_TextureMip_SelectVariantImage selects either the base texture image or a variant image based on the renderer mip-selection flag and the polygon mip metric.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte target covers 0x499130 but remains below tier S: verify vc5 0x499130 reports 250 unmasked function-byte mismatches after 24 relocation-masked bytes and 15 trimmed VC NOP bytes, BN size 372 bytes and VC5 symbol size 384 bytes after source-shape probes were reverted.
VC5SP3 data-symbol target zrndr_texture_mip_select_variant_data passes for gRndr_TextureMipSelectionEnabled and gRndr_TextureMipReservedWriteOnly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x499130 validates the disabled-mip-selection base/null returns, closest-depth vertex scan, mip metric max-reduction from the three 2D parameter vectors, conversion to a variant index, and call to zImage_TexDirEntry::GetVariantImageAtIndex.
The native smoke verifies disabled selection returning the base image and null entry handling, then enabled selection returning the linked variant image for the exercised metric.
